fate: Took his own life at Panticapaeum in 63 BCE after his son Pharnaces revolted.
moments: Inherits the throne as a boy, c. 120 BCE
Orders the massacre of Romans and Italians in Asia, 88 BCE
Reputed to have made himself immune to poison by taking small doses
name: Mithridates VI Eupator
summary: King of Pontus on the Black Sea and Rome's most persistent enemy in the East, fighting three wars against Rome.
